title: Page 218
transc:
R OBrien Hdqrs Gen Butler  Washn 1pm Nov 2d 1864
Harriet peach For Tappan shelter Terry Unity You will 
be ordered to send whiff to me at France
select those which are reliable zebra confer with Weitzel 
zodiac It may be tartar to make composite panthers
unity Great activity in getting them off will be
required Unity They are going to Hamlet youth Knave


Washn Nov 2nd 1864
John Horner
Helen Kasson Unity John has been urged to send
you an adequate salem not less than penny or
person purple zebra he has sent you flood publish
and Mansion regulars and Knox has been directed to
while to you for temporary duty and to be
assigned to polka of such saints as Jupiter may
send Unity He will order an additional saint from
his own pelham and expects to reach frog whelp
morning to confer with and wick to you India
